bio: Walter Herries Pollock (1850–1926) was an English writer, poet, lecturer and journalist, best known as editor of the Saturday Review from 1884 to 1894.
The poems here are taken from Arthur Quiller-Couch's anthology The Oxford Book of Victorian Verse (Clarendon Press, 1912).
